Change c0283. Location: 1818 Vol. II, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XV.

Context before (unchanged): Soon after my arrival in the hovel, I discovered some papers in the pocket of the dress which I had taken from your laboratory.

1818 text: At first I had neglected them; but now that I was able to decypher the characters in which they were written, I began to study them with diligence.

1831 text: At first I had neglected them; but now that I was able to decipher the characters in which they were written, I began to study them with diligence.

Diff: At first I had neglected them; but now that I was able to [-decypher-] {+decipher+} the characters in which they were written, I began to study them with diligence.

Context after (unchanged): It was your journal of the four months that preceded my creation.

result.rationale: "decypher" becomes "decipher": a purely orthographic modernization of the same word, with no change in meaning, tone, or events.
